args.title: Brightline Freight: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Brightline Freight newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

- Newsletter: This week's Brightline Freight newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to a feature article on the topic (https://blog.brightline.example/2026/returns).
- Article: Return rates for apparel reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
